needed.evidence: The right side of the road lacks a paved sidewalk, featuring only an uneven, unpaved dirt and gravel shoulder where pedestrians are walking.
needed.suggestion: Construct a paved, continuous footway on the right side of the road to provide a safe, level surface for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: The unpaved shoulder on the right side of the road is uneven and contains potholes and loose gravel, creating significant trip hazards for pedestrians.
needed.suggestion: Resurface the right-side shoulder with a durable, level material to eliminate trip hazards and create a safe walking path.

needed.evidence: Pedestrians are seen walking in the roadway and attempting to cross at an unmarked location, indicating a high demand for a safe crossing facility that is not.
needed.suggestion: Install a clearly marked pedestrian crossing with a central refuge island to provide a safe and visible place for people to cross the road.
